add.title: India joins US-led Pax Silica agreement to secure AI supply chains, semiconductors, critical minerals and advanced manufacturing technologies through cooperation with strategic partners
India and US have agreed on preferential American market access for Indian exports, Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal confirms, although final tariff negotiations remain pending
Finance Ministry considers uniform customs-duty and GST deferment rules for battery storage projects, addressing inconsistent state-level implementation and rising imported equipment costs
RBI's cybersecurity guidelines require non-bank payment operators to report cyberattacks, critical outages and settlement disruptions within six hours, strengthening oversight of digital payments
NITI Aayog prepares policy blueprint to accelerate domestic gold exploration and mining through fiscal incentives, regulatory reforms and longer mining rights, reducing import dependence
Prime Minister Modi begins Philippines visit for ASEAN-India and East Asia summits, prioritising trade, connectivity, maritime security and strategic cooperation across the Indo-Pacific

India and Egypt deepen industrial and infrastructure cooperation, discussing joint manufacturing, logistics, technology partnerships and stronger supply chains as Egypt positions itself as India's African gateway
Commerce Ministry reports double-digit export growth across eight of India's ten largest markets during April-October FY27, while China's widening trade surplus highlights import dependence
Environment Minister Bhupendra Yadav selected to co-facilitate COP31 emissions-reduction negotiations, balancing India's opposition to mandatory fossil-fuel phaseout with global climate commitments
Centre identifies major governance gaps in state-level AI, geospatial and microbiome systems, citing fragmented datasets, weak data-protection implementation and inadequate institutional coordination
NITI Aayog finds advanced battery PLI scheme has delivered only 1.4 GWh capacity against its 50 GWh target, with commercial production yet to begin
Tamil Nadu imposes stock limits on rice, paddy and pulses, restricting wholesale, retail and importer inventories to contain food inflation and prevent hoarding
